title: The World's Oceans
text: Earth's oceans -- the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic -- cover about 71% of the planet's surface and hold roughly 97% of its water. The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest, containing the Mariana Trench, the deepest known point on Earth at nearly 11,000 meters. Oceans regulate global climate, generate much of the oxygen we breathe (via phytoplankton), and support vast biodiversity.
